comment:
* Helper class that reads and writes Global.Setting values for Telephony. It will:
 * For Single SIM case, read from or write to the singleton setting value.
 * For Multi-SIM case, read from or write to the per subscription value.

methods.name: public static int getInt(Context context, String settingName, int subId, int defaultValue)
methods.comment: * Helper function to get integer value.

methods.name: public static boolean getBoolean(Context context, String settingName, int subId, boolean defaultValue)
methods.comment: * Helper function to get boolean value.

methods.name: public static boolean getBoolean(Context context, String settingName, int subId) throws SettingNotFoundException
methods.comment: * Helper function to get boolean value or throws SettingNotFoundException if not set.

methods.name: public static boolean setInt(Context context, String settingName, int subId, int value)
methods.comment:
* Helper function to set integer value.
     * Returns whether the value is changed or initially set.

methods.name: public static boolean setBoolean(Context context, String settingName, int subId, boolean value)
methods.comment:
* Helper function to set boolean value.
     * Returns whether the value is changed or initially set.
